simple.meaning: שָׁתַן (shâthan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “(causatively) to make water , i.e. urinate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, beginning at 1 Samuel 25:22. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁתַן (H8366) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁתַן (shâthan) / H8366 is traced through 1 Samuel 25:22, 1 Samuel 25:34, 1 Kings 14:10, 1 Kings 16:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.” † or, male.
